address: Avenida Pedro Álvares Cabral 1301, São Paulo, 04094-050, Brazil
bio: Occupying the top floor of the MAC USP (Museu de Arte Contemporânea da Universidade de São Paulo), this restaurant boasts spectacular views of Ibirapuera and a 360° panorama of the city. The kitchen is run by chef Pedro Oliveira, who offers guests a traditional Brazilian dining experience featuring typical ingredients from the country’s five regions, which he prepares in a harmonious and balanced way and is showcased on an “executive”-style format at lunchtime. On Saturdays, pumpkin shrimp with rice and sweet potato chips is the highlight, with crispy pururuca pork making an appearance on Sundays.
